objective: Implement and qualify the reviewed native TransitContext V2 typed DTO/capture/restore contract only.
steps: Verify exact base/source hashes, absent new test path, bound inputs, durable native archive acceptance, joined native result and root dispatch authority before editing.
Implement only the typed native V2 DTO/action/witness and native capture/restore API in the two ABM Rust sources.
Add actual native DTO capture/restore proofs in the new ABM integration test. Preserve V1 and do not add wire/codec methods.
Format owned Rust files before the exact ordered packet gates; any failure stops for root review. Do not retry or repair until root publishes a fresh GO authority matching the failed receipt list.

verification.oracle: Pinned Rust/Cargo 1.99 strict all-target Clippy passes for kairo-ecs-abm at unchanged source hashes.
Full kairo-ecs-abm package tests pass with all ten exact TransitContext V2 native names and unchanged V1 tests.
Rustfmt check passes on exactly the three owned Rust paths.

acceptance: Typed DTO fields and action/witness variants match the committed ADR exactly.
Native restore enforces the ADR validation order, current Handoff work binding, historical issued event and ticket joins, bounds and phase rules.
All ten named native V2 proofs pass; full existing ABM/V1 behavior passes; no wire or codec changes are made.
Ready_for_review requires three ordered successful gates at unchanged final source hashes.
stop_conditions: Any HEAD/input/source hash, artifact claim, or root authority drift.
Any edit beyond the three owned Rust paths.
Any wire, manifest, codec, V1 layout, DES, calibration, consumer or parent change.

Missing owner API, semantic mismatch with ADR, unavailable Rust/Cargo 1.99, or any gate failure. A failed gate stops execution for root review; corrections require a fresh root GO authority bound to all failed receipt paths. Preserve all attempts and stop at three failures; no automatic retry.
size_exception: Three owned Rust paths plus a separate result and gate logs are required for the native DTO, consumer proofs, and three source gates.

result_contract.status: ready_for_review only when readiness passes; otherwise in_progress
result_contract.initial_owned_path_verification: worker records exact two baseline hashes and confirms the new test file is absent before editing
result_contract.base_source_hashes: exact packet baseline for existing flow_adapter.rs and lib.rs
result_contract.owned_source_hashes: current/final hashes for all three owned Rust paths
result_contract.required_success_names: observed successful required names from terminal tests receipt
result_contract.required_success_count: observed count; zero until tests receipt
result_contract.failed_development_attempts: all failed terminal raw result receipt paths; corrections require root-published GO authority exactly binding the complete failed receipt list
result_contract.gate_readiness: latest Clippy, tests, format receipts all pass in order with matching final source hashes; each terminal receipt binds its started receipt hash and exact immutable argv/cwd/HEAD/toolchain/source set

dispatch_authority_contract.writer: root only; worker must not create or edit this file

repair_fields.repair_authorized: true only on explicit root GO after a failed gate
repair_fields.repair_authorized_after_failures: exact ordered/complete failed terminal receipt paths; empty before any failures
